title: Contract Clause Index and Comparison
initial_prompt: Read TASK.md and complete the requested workflow using only the Python standard library.

stages.message: Read TASK.md and complete the requested workflow using only the Python standard library.

`inputs/review_set.csv` names 18 contracts under renewal review. Generate `output/comparison.md` grouping conflicting renewal windows, liability caps, and governing-law states, with source line ranges for each statement.

Some newly added agreements in `inputs/contracts-late/` have headings wrapped across two lines. Include that directory and update the parser without weakening the line citations. A wrapped heading's citation starts at its first heading line.
